invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.21.0 preserves Parts 1–24 and adds Part 25 Reports & Analytics without a tenant schema change: server-side report permission gates protect the analytics read model, monetary analytics normalize to company/base currency, zero-filled 12-month billing and collection trends avoid misleading gaps, customer exposure, item performance, tax and payment-method views extend the existing reporting model, CSV analytics export remains separately permission-gated, and the mobile UI uses focused report tabs instead of stacking every report into one long page.
